input.issue:
Add support for providing credentials via environment variables
As an alternative to passing user credentials as arguments to `rest_api.get_access_token()`, it would be useful to also have the option of providing these via shell environment variables, for example:
```
export INAT_USERNAME=""
export INAT_PASSWORD=""
export INAT_APP_ID=""
export INAT_APP_SECRET=""
```

This is a pretty common pattern in other applications (for example, the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-envvars.html)), since environment variables offer a bit more flexibility. For example, creds can be stored in the system keychain or other secure format and then loaded with something like `export INAT_PASSWORD=$(secret-tool lookup ...)`.

There is also the python [keyring](https://github.com/jaraco/keyring) package that provides convenient integration with the system keyring, but that could be a separate issue (EDIT: created #69 for this).

If both function arguments and environment variables were to be specified, function arguments would take precedence.
